messages.subject: Assistance with creating a radarchart from the selected items in the datatable output in Shiny...
parts:
Hello, please excuse my lack of knowledge, I have only been using R for a few weeks.....

I am trying to create a radarchart from the selected items from the datatable output in shiny.

Here is my code:

###############################################################UI:
# Libraries
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(radarchart)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
shinyUI(fluidPage(theme = "bootstrap.css",
                 
                  # Application title
                  titlePanel("Leonardo Deartiaga's Shiny App"),
                  h4("Please use the drop menus and slider bar to filter players."),
                  #Create a new row in the Ui for selectInputs
                 
                  fluidRow(
                   
                   
                   
                   
                    column(4,
                           selectInput("Nationality",
                                       "Nationality:",
                                       c("All",
                                         unique(as.character(data$Nationality))))
                          
                    ),
                    column(4,
                           selectInput("Club",
                                       "Club:",
                                       c("All",
                                         unique(as.character(data$Club))))
                          
                    ),
                    column(4,
                           selectInput("Club_Position",
                                       "Club Position:",
                                       c("All",
                                         unique(as.character(data$Club_Position))))
                          
                    ),
                    column(4,
                           sliderInput("Rating",
                                       "Player Rating , Greater than >:",
                                       0,100,94)
                    ),
                   
                   
                   
                    #Create a new row for the table
                    fluidRow(
                     
                      DT::dataTableOutput("table"),
                      verbatimTextOutput("table_output"),
                      chartJSRadarOutput("radar", width = "50",height = "50")
                     
                     
                    )
                  )
)
)

###########################################################Server


# Libraries
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(radarchart)


data <- read.csv("Data.csv")
attach(data)

# Define server logic
function(input, output) {
 


  data <- data %>%
    select(Name,Nationality,Club_Kit,Club,Club_Position,Club_Joining,Rating,Height,Weight,Preffered_Foot,Birth_Date,Age)%>%
    arrange(Nationality)
 
  #Filter based on Selection
  output$table = DT::renderDataTable(DT::datatable({
   
   
    data
   
   
    if(input$Nationality != "All"){
      data <- data[data$Nationality == input$Nationality,]
    }
    if(input$Club != "All"){
      data <- data[data$Club == input$Club,]
    }
    if(input$Club_Position != "All"){
      data <- data[data$Club_Position == input$Club_Position,]
    }
   
    if(input$Rating != "All"){
      data <- data[data$Rating >= input$Rating,]
    }
   
   
    data
  }))
 
# Any Help would be appreciated.
  output$radar = renderChartJSRadar({
   
 
   
    chartJSRadar()
   
   
  } )
 
}

---------------------------------

I want to do something like below, but to where the radarchart is populated by the selected item from the data table. 

library(radarchart)
library(tidyr)
#Selecting top players by rating from data
top20 <- head(FullData, 20)

radarDF <- top20 %>% select(Name, 18:53) %>% as.data.frame()

radarDF <- gather(radarDF, key=Label, value=Score, -Name) %>%
  spread(key=Name, value=Score)

chartJSRadar(scores = radarDF, maxScale = 100, showToolTipLabel = TRUE)



Thanks!!!
